example.en: After my studies I will look for a job.

example.el: Οι συνθήκες στο γραφείο είναι καλές.
example.en: The conditions in the office are good.

example.en: My sister is younger than my brother.

example.el: Αν και κάνει κρύο, πάμε στη θάλασσα.
example.en: Although it is cold, we go to the sea.
example.tr: Hava soğuk olmasına rağmen denize gidiyoruz.

en: even though; despite the fact that

example.el: Παρόλο που η δουλειά είναι μακριά, ο μισθός είναι καλός.
example.en: Even though the job is far away, the salary is good.
example.tr: İş uzak olmasına rağmen maaş iyi.

prompt.el: Γιατί θα πάρει η Αϊσέ τη δεύτερη δουλειά;
prompt.en: Why will Ayşe take the second job?

options: Επειδή είναι κοντά στο σπίτι και το ωράριο είναι καλύτερο.

explain.en: «Τη δεύτερη, επειδή είναι κοντά στο σπίτι και το ωράριο είναι καλύτερο.» The salary of the second job is actually worse.
explain.tr: «Τη δεύτερη, επειδή είναι κοντά στο σπίτι και το ωράριο είναι καλύτερο.» İkinci işin maaşı aslında daha kötü.

statements.el: Η πρώτη εταιρεία έχει καλύτερο μισθό.
statements.en: The first company has the better salary.

statements.el: Η δεύτερη δουλειά έχει εννιά ώρες τη μέρα.
statements.en: The second job has nine hours a day.
statements.tr: İkinci işte günde dokuz saat var.

statements.el: Η Αϊσέ έχει ρεπό τα Σαββατοκύριακα στη δεύτερη δουλειά.
statements.en: In the second job Ayşe has weekends off.
statements.tr: İkinci işte Ayşe hafta sonları izinli.

statements.el: Η δεύτερη δουλειά έχει είκοσι πέντε μέρες άδεια.
statements.en: The second job has twenty-five days of leave.
statements.tr: İkinci işte yirmi beş gün izin var.

explain.en: The first company pays better, but its day is nine hours. The second has eight hours, weekends off and twenty-five days of leave.
explain.tr: Birinci şirket daha iyi öder ama günü dokuz saat. İkincisinde sekiz saat, hafta sonları izin ve yirmi beş gün yıllık izin var.

translation.en: I learn Greek to find a job.
translation.tr: Bir iş bulmak için Yunanca öğreniyorum.

explain.en: A goal takes για να and the once-only form βρω. γιατί and επειδή give a reason and need an ordinary verb (βρίσκω), not βρω.
explain.tr: Amaç için για να ve bir kerelik biçim βρω gelir. γιατί ve επειδή neden bildirir ve sıradan bir fiil ister (βρίσκω), βρω değil.

prompt.el: — ___ θα πάρεις τη δεύτερη δουλειά; — Επειδή είναι πιο κοντά.
prompt.en: — ___ will you take the second job? — Because it is closer.
prompt.tr: — İkinci işi ___ alacaksın? — Çünkü daha yakın.

explain.en: The question word is Γιατί («why?»). The answer begins with Επειδή («because»). Για να would give a purpose.
explain.tr: Soru kelimesi Γιατί («neden?»). Cevap Επειδή («çünkü») ile başlar. Για να amaç bildirirdi.

text: {1} ο μισθός είναι καλύτερος, δε θέλω την πρώτη δουλειά.

translation.en: Although the salary is better, I do not want the first job.
translation.tr: Maaş daha iyi olmasına rağmen birinci işi istemiyorum.

explain.en: The two parts go against each other, so Αν και («although») fits. Γιατί would make the better salary the reason for not wanting the job, and Για να gives a purpose and needs the form used after να.
explain.tr: İki parça birbirine ters düşüyor, bu yüzden Αν και («-e rağmen») uyar. Γιατί iyi maaşı işi istememenin nedeni yapardı; Για να ise bir amaç söyler ve να ile kullanılan biçimi ister.

text: Ο μισθός στην πρώτη εταιρεία είναι {1} από τον μισθό στη δεύτερη. Το μετρό πάει {2} από το λεωφορείο.

translation.en: The salary at the first company is better than the salary at the second. The metro goes faster than the bus.
translation.tr: Birinci şirketteki maaş ikincisindekinden daha iyi. Metro otobüsten daha hızlı gidiyor.

explain.en: 1: ο μισθός is masculine and comes after είναι, so the adjective καλύτερος. καλύτερα is the adverb, and «πιο καλύτερος» says «more» twice. 2: πάει is a verb, and how something goes is said with an adverb: πιο γρήγορα. πιο γρήγορος is an adjective (it goes with είναι: Το μετρό είναι πιο γρήγορο), and γρήγορα alone does not compare.
explain.tr: 1: ο μισθός eril ve είναι fiilinden sonra geliyor, bu yüzden sıfat: καλύτερος. καλύτερα zarftır; «πιο καλύτερος» ise «daha»yı iki kez söyler. 2: πάει bir fiil; nasıl gittiğini zarf söyler: πιο γρήγορα. πιο γρήγορος bir sıfattır (είναι ile kullanılır: Το μετρό είναι πιο γρήγορο); tek başına γρήγορα ise karşılaştırma yapmaz.

rubric.el: Συμπληρώνω τα κενά με τον σωστό τύπο.
rubric.en: Fill the gaps with the right article.

text: Στην Αθήνα, αυτός είναι {1} πιο ακριβός δρόμος, αυτή είναι {2} πιο ακριβή περιοχή και αυτό είναι {3} πιο ακριβό μαγαζί.

translation.en: In Athens, this is the most expensive street, this is the most expensive area and this is the most expensive shop.
translation.tr: Atina'da bu en pahalı cadde, bu en pahalı semt ve bu en pahalı dükkân.

explain.en: The superlative has the article, and it agrees with the noun: ο δρόμος (m), η περιοχή (f), το μαγαζί (n).
explain.tr: En üstünlükte artikel var ve isimle uyar: ο δρόμος (eril), η περιοχή (dişil), το μαγαζί (nötr).

ask.en: Which sentence is correct? (I work in order to live.)

prompt.en: Which sentence is correct? (I work in order to live.)

explain.en: The purpose needs the two words together, για να, before the verb.
explain.tr: Amaç için iki kelime birlikte gelir, για να, fiilden önce.

prompt.el: — Γιατί δεν έρχεσαι στη γιορτή; — ___ έχω δουλειά.
prompt.en: — Why aren't you coming to the celebration? — ___ I have work.

explain.en: The answer to «why?» gives a reason: Επειδή. Για να gives a purpose («in order to have work»), and Αν και («although») is the opposite of a reason.
explain.tr: «Neden?» sorusunun cevabı bir nedendir: Επειδή. Για να bir amaç söyler («iş sahibi olmak için»), Αν και («-e rağmen») ise nedenin tersidir.

rubric.el: Συμπληρώνω τα κενά. Μία λέξη περισσεύει.
rubric.en: Fill the gaps. One word is not needed.

text: Η δουλειά είναι κοντά στο σπίτι, {1} ο μισθός είναι χειρότερος. {2} ο μισθός είναι χειρότερος, θα την πάρω.

translation.en: The job is near home, but the salary is worse. Although the salary is worse, I will take it.
translation.tr: İş eve yakın, ama maaş daha kötü. Maaş daha kötü olmasına rağmen alacağım.

explain.en: Gap 1 joins two main clauses: αλλά. Gap 2 opens a clause in front of the main one, and its fact goes against the decision: Αν και. Επειδή would make the worse salary the reason for taking the job.
explain.tr: 1. boşluk iki ana cümleyi bağlar: αλλά. 2. boşluk ana cümleden önce gelen bir yan cümle açar ve bu bilgi karara ters düşer: Αν και. Επειδή, kötü maaşı işi almanın nedeni yapardı.

prompt.el: Η Ελένη γράφει ___ από τον αδελφό της.

explain.en: γράφει is a verb, so it takes the adverb καλύτερα (from καλά). καλύτερη is the feminine adjective: Eleni is a woman, but nothing here is described by an adjective. πιο καλύτερα says «more» twice.
explain.tr: γράφει bir fiil, bu yüzden zarf gelir: καλύτερα (καλά kelimesinden). καλύτερη dişil sıfattır: Eleni kadın, ama burada sıfatla anlatılan bir şey yok. πιο καλύτερα ise «daha»yı iki kez söyler.

prompt.el: Η Αθήνα είναι ___ πόλη της Ελλάδας.

explain.en: The superlative needs the article, and it agrees with η πόλη (f): η πιο μεγάλη. Without the article, πιο μεγάλη means «bigger» and would need από.
explain.tr: En üstünlükte artikel gerekir ve η πόλη (dişil) ile uyar: η πιο μεγάλη. Artikelsiz πιο μεγάλη «daha büyük» demektir ve από ister.

rubric.el: Βάζω κάθε λέξη στη σωστή ομάδα.
rubric.en: Sort each comparative: πιο + a word, or one word.
rubric.tr: Her karşılaştırmayı ayır: πιο + kelime ya da tek kelime.

explain.en: πιο + an adjective or adverb works with almost every word. Four common adjectives also have a one-word form to learn as a word: καλύτερος, χειρότερος, μεγαλύτερος, μικρότερος.
explain.tr: πιο + sıfat ya da zarf neredeyse her kelimeyle olur. Dört sık sıfatın ayrıca kelime olarak öğrenilecek tek kelimelik biçimi var: καλύτερος, χειρότερος, μεγαλύτερος, μικρότερος.

rubric.en: Match each adjective with its comparative.

explain.en: καλός → καλύτερος, κακός → χειρότερος, μεγάλος → μεγαλύτερος, μικρός → μικρότερος.
explain.tr: καλός → καλύτερος, κακός → χειρότερος, μεγάλος → μεγαλύτερος, μικρός → μικρότερος.

rubric.el: Συμπληρώνω τα κενά. Μία λέξη περισσεύει.
rubric.en: Fill the gaps. One word is not needed.

text: Στη δουλειά μου παίρνω καλό {1}, αλλά το {2} είναι μεγάλο: εννιά ώρες τη μέρα. Τον Αύγουστο παίρνω είκοσι μέρες {3}.

translation.en: At my job I get a good salary, but the hours are long: nine hours a day. In August I take twenty days of leave.
translation.tr: İşimde iyi maaş alıyorum, ama çalışma saatleri uzun: günde dokuz saat. Ağustosta yirmi gün izin alıyorum.

explain.en: καλό μισθό (a good salary: what you get at work), το ωράριο (the hours: the only neuter word), μέρες άδεια (days of leave). συνάδελφο, «colleague», fits none of the gaps.
explain.tr: καλό μισθό (iyi maaş: işte alınan şey), το ωράριο (saatler: tek nötr kelime), μέρες άδεια (izin günleri). συνάδελφο, «iş arkadaşı», hiçbir boşluğa uymaz.
